$comment: EXAMPLE ONLY (P1). The deployment's non-secret installation configuration in mc.installation_config.v1 shape, referenced by MISSION_CONTROL_INSTALLATION_CONFIG_PATH: one mapping per Application. A manifest variable's value_ref: config:<key> resolves in its Application's mapping at compile; an Application not listed has no values (its keys stay config_unresolved). Never a credential: a key containing key|token|secret|password|passwd|dsn|credential is refused at load and at compile; declare credentials under a manifest's secrets instead.
